title.narrative: Scaling Up for Universal Coverage and Impact - South Sudan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: South Sudan, Malaria, Population Services International (PSI HQ)This program has the following goals: By 2021, Reduce malaria reported morbidity and deaths by 80% of 2013 level. The NSP goal: By 2021, Reduce the malaria parasite prevalence by 50% of 2013 level. The grant targets to achieve 30% of the 2013 baseline by 2020.. The objectives of this program are: To strengthen and sustain the management and coordination capacity of the malaria programme at all levels by 2021. To ensure that 85% of the population at risk are protected by recommended malaria prevention methods by 2021. The NSP Objective:To achieve 90% parasitological diagnosis and treatment of all presented malaria cases according to the national guidelines by 2021. The current grant will achieve less targets (75% parasitological testing) because programme is starting form lower baselines. To increase to at least 80%, community and health worker knowledge, attitudes and practices on malaria prevention and control by 2021. Establish malaria emergency preparedness and ensure timely malaria control responses in all communities affected by conflict, natural disaster or epidemics by 2021. Ensure 80% of health facilities routinely report on core malaria indicators by 2021
